jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: Field alignment is strong (human rights, strategic litigation aligns with candidate's international law and justice interests), but this is a Manager-level role in the Reprieve pay band requiring substantial litigation and management experience the candidate lacks. Likely also requires legal qualification for strategic litigation leadership. Hard ineligibility on seniority.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Senior Digital Forensics Consultant
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility on seniority — the role requires a minimum of 8 years of professional experience plus expert-witness capability and deep specialist digital forensics tooling (Cellebrite, AXIOM, X-Ways, FTK), none of which the candidate has. While S-RM is a target firm in the commercial intelligence zone, this is a senior technical specialist position far beyond the candidate's stage.

jobs.title: Policy Fellow – Bloomberg LSE Mayoral Strategic Authorities Programme
jobs.reason: This is a senior Policy Fellow role requiring substantial experience leading projects in public policy/government, designing executive education, and deep expertise in UK local government and devolution — well beyond the candidate's MSc-in-progress stage and student-assistant experience. The field (UK domestic devolution and city governance) is also adjacent rather than core to the candidate's IR/international law focus. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: HR Administrative Assistant (AD.11.4)
jobs.reason: This is an HR administrative support role with no connection to the candidate's policy, research, or intelligence targets — pure HR/talent administration falls in the field mismatch category. The role also requires 3 years of prior HR experience, which the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Account Director
jobs.reason: This is a senior PR account leadership role for a global sportswear brand — outside the candidate's policy/research/intelligence target zones. The Account Director title requires substantial agency/client leadership experience, team management, and budget ownership that the candidate (MSc in progress, student-assistant background) does not have. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Post-Doctoral Fellowship (AC.09.4)
jobs.reason: Hard ineligibility on multiple counts: the role requires a completed PhD (candidate is MSc in progress) and specialist expertise in population genetics, bioinformatics, and genomic data analysis — none of which the candidate has. The field (molecular bioscience) is entirely unrelated to IR/policy.

jobs.title: ASSISTANT ANIMAL ATTENDANT.9.07 (AD.13.5)
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — animal husbandry role in a research animal facility requires hands-on animal care experience and is entirely unrelated to the candidate's IR/policy background. Requires minimum 2 years of experience working with animals, which the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Recruitment Coordinator, London
jobs.reason: Although S-RM is a core target firm in commercial intelligence, this is an HR/Talent Acquisition role with no analytical or research content — pure recruitment coordination falls under the "HR/talent" mismatch category. The candidate's research and policy skills do not transfer meaningfully to ATS management and candidate screening.

jobs.title: Internal Communications Manager
jobs.reason: This is an internal communications management role in a university comms team — not policy or research, and outside all three target zones. The role explicitly requires demonstrable team management experience and senior stakeholder advisory experience (Grade 8, Manager title with line management duties), which the candidate does not have. Hard ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Power Platform Developer
jobs.reason: This is a specialist Microsoft Power Platform developer role requiring 3+ years of hands-on experience with Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and ITIL processes — none of which align with the candidate's IR/policy research profile. Both field and skills are a clear mismatch.

jobs.title: Monitoring, Evaluation & Learning Officer - Response & Impact
jobs.reason: MEL roles at development consultancies sit outside the candidate's core targets (academic/policy research, commercial intelligence, OSINT/hybrid tech). While research and data analysis skills could partially transfer, MEL typically requires specific methodological training (logframes, theories of change, development evaluation frameworks) the candidate lacks, and the role is unlikely to be entry-level given the "Officer" framing.

jobs.title: Digital Forensics Associate
jobs.reason: Although S-RM is a target-zone intelligence consultancy, this is a specialist digital forensics role requiring hands-on technical expertise with tools like Cellebrite, AXIOM, X-Ways, FTK and forensic acquisition of Windows/MacOS/iOS/Android devices — none of which the candidate has. The role also asks for 3+ years of professional forensic/technical investigation experience and the ability to lead investigations and manage clients, which exceeds the candidate's student-assistant background.

jobs.title: Senior HR Business Partner (UK)
jobs.reason: This is a senior HR business partner role, which is a complete mismatch for the candidate's IR research profile. HR is not a target field, the candidate lacks HR-specific expertise, and the "Senior" level requires substantial professional HR experience the candidate does not have.
